And the words of the prophet who came from Judah to Jeroboam were fulfilled.
And in the thirty-first year of Josiah, Necho {OCR: ܢܲܕ݂ܵܐܘܼܬ݂ -> ܢܟܐܘ}, who is Pharaoh the Lame, reigned in Egypt.
He went down to the river Euphrates, against Mabbugh,
to wage war against the king of Assyria.
And when Josiah went out against him,
Josiah was killed there by Necho {OCR: ܢܲܟܵܐܘܼܬ݂ -> ܢܟܐܘ}.
And his servants brought him and buried him in Jerusalem.
After Josiah: Jehoahaz,
his son, three months.
Him Pharaoh the Lame took away into captivity when he returned,
and set up in his place Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, his brother.
After Jehoahaz:
Jehoiakim his brother, eleven years.
He is the one who was called Eliakim.
And Pharaoh the Lame set him up in place of his brother,
imposing upon him to pay every year one hundred talents of gold.
And in the third year of Eliakim, Nebuchadnezzar the Chaldean, son of Nabopolassar, reigned over the Assyrians forty-four years.
And he went up against Jerusalem,
and took away captives and the vessels of the temple,
and imposed tribute on Eliakim and departed.
In this captivity Daniel and his companions went down to Babylon;
this is the first captivity to Babylon.
Now Pharaoh the Lame, after he had devastated Mabbugh and killed Josiah, and had returned,
came again a second time and encamped on the Euphrates,
and there Nebuchadnezzar killed him.
And in the eighth year of Jehoiakim, and the fifth of Nebuchadnezzar, he went up again against Jerusalem,
and imposed tribute upon Jehoiakim and returned.
And in the eighth year of {OCR: ܪܲܢܒ݂ܘܼܟܲܕ݂ܢܵܨ̇ܪ -> ܕܲܢܒ݂ܘܼܟܲܕ݂ܢܵܨܲܪ} Nebuchadnezzar, Jehoiakim died.
After Jehoiakim: Jehoiachin his son.
He is the one who is called Jeconiah in the Gospel of Matthew,
who was also called Jehoiakim after the name of his father.
He reigned three months,
and his heart turned aside from the Lord.
And Nebuchadnezzar went up a third time,
and took him captive, along with his mother and the princes,
and carried them away to Babylon.
And he was there in prison for thirty-seven years.
And he set up in his place Zedekiah his uncle, the son of Josiah.
After Jehoiachin: Zedekiah his uncle {OCR: ܪܕܵܕܗ -> ܕܵܕܹܗ}, eleven years.
And in the fourth year of Zedekiah, Astyages reigned over the Medes thirty-eight years.
And in the nineteenth year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar,
which is the eleventh of Zedekiah,
Nebuchadnezzar went up a fourth time against Judah.
